Based on my recollection, roughly half (about 50%) of Mexican respondents who used these public services reported paying a bribe in the prior year, as of the 2017 Global Corruption Barometer for Latin America. I can't check the source from here, so treat that figure as unverified. The Transparency International GCB 2017 Latin America report or the World Bank's SDG 16.5.1 bribery data would confirm it.
